What will you be doing?Operations and Administration Supporting the effective day-to-day administration and operation of the community dermatology service. Managing referrals, waiting lists, appointments, correspondence and patient records. Ensuring administrative processes are completed accurately, efficiently and within required timescales. When required, supporting or overseeing the day-to-day work of the administration team, ensuring priorities are managed effectively and tasks are completed. Maintaining accurate spreadsheets, databases, trackers and monitoring systems. Supporting month-end processes and providing accurate information to management. Compliance and Quality Monitoring compliance with PriDerm policies, procedures and service requirements. Carrying out regular audits and quality checks to ensure processes are being followed correctly. Checking records and administrative activity for accuracy and completeness. Maintaining compliance trackers and action logs. Identifying errors, gaps, risks or areas where processes are not being followed and escalating these appropriately. Following up outstanding actions to ensure they are completed within agreed timescales. Supporting the preparation and maintenance of evidence required for audits, reviews and compliance monitoring. Supporting the implementation of new policies, procedures and operational processes. Reporting and Monitoring Producing regular operational and compliance reports using Excel and other systems. Monitoring service activity, waiting lists, referrals, appointments and other key performance information. Identifying trends, discrepancies or areas of concern within the data. Providing accurate information and reports to management to support decision-making. Maintaining accurate and up-to-date monitoring systems and ensuring information is readily available when required. Service Improvement Identifying opportunities to improve administrative processes and the way the service operates. Working with colleagues to implement improvements and monitor their effectiveness. Supporting investigations into administrative errors, process failures or areas of non-compliance where required. Taking ownership of agreed actions and seeing them through to completion. Working collaboratively with the wider team to promote high standards of quality, accuracy and compliance. Working hours Monday - Thursday: until 5:30pm Friday: until 4:30pm Start time: To be confirmed Please note: This position does not include an NHS pension. About PriDerm Community Dermatology Service PriDerm Community Dermatology Service provides dermatology care to the local community in North Kirklees . We are a busy service delivering a range of community dermatology clinics and supporting patients throughout their care pathway. Our administrative and operational teams play a vital role in ensuring that patients receive an efficient, well-organised and high-quality service.

title: Medical Administrator
description: Oakwood Lane Medical Practice is delighted to offer an opportunity for a dedicated Medical Administrator to join our friendly, forward thinking team. We care for a diverse population of over 14,000 patients and pride ourselves on delivering high quality, patient centred healthcare. We are looking for an enthusiastic, organised and proactive administrator who is passionate about supporting excellent patient care. You will play a key role in ensuring patients receive the right care at the right time, contributing to the smooth and efficient running of the practice. Join us and become part of a supportive, inclusive and dynamic team committed to delivering outstanding healthcare. Document and Record Management Process, scan and code incoming clinical correspondence. Assign documents to the correct clinician or administrative team promptly and accurately. Identify and escalate urgent or clinically significant information. Liaise with clinicians to clarify documentation queries and ensure appropriate action. Maintain accurate patient records using workflow systems. Process incoming and outgoing patient records. Referral Administration Complete and submit patient referrals to specialists and external providers, ensuring all documentation is accurate and complete. Take ownership of referrals from initiation to completion, including monitoring rejections and responses. Provide clear information to patients regarding referral pathways and progress. Ensure all referral communications are documented and filed appropriately. Insurance and Third Party Requests Manage insurance forms, medical reports and third party documentation with accuracy and compliance. Support patients and staff with queries relating to access to medical records and permissions. General Administrative Support Provide flexible administrative cover across departments as required. Support statutory and contractual practice obligations. Assist with ad-hoc administrative tasks to ensure smooth day to day operations. Work collaboratively with colleagues and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. Process, scan and code incoming clinical correspondence including hospital letters, discharge summaries, ambulance notifications and out of hours reports. Review correspondence and ensure documents are attached to the correct patient record. Code or free text clinical information on to the patient record. Assign documents to the appropriate clinician or administrative team promptly and accurately. Identify urgent, abnormal or clinically significant information and escalate in accordance with practice procedures. Liaise with clinical staff to clarify documentation queries and ensure appropriate actions are completed. Maintain accurate patient records using practice workflow and clinical systems. Process incoming and outgoing patient records in accordance with NHS and practice procedures, ensuring records are transferred, received and managed accurately and securely. Monitor workflow queues to ensure correspondence is processed within agreed timescales. Deal with queries relating to correspondence management and document processing. Complete and submit referrals to secondary care, community services and external providers, ensuring all supporting documentation is accurate and complete. Take ownership of referrals from initiation through to completion. Monitor referral progress, including rejected referrals, requests for further information and provider responses. Liaise with clinicians to obtain information required to support referrals. Provide patients with information regarding referral pathways, appointments and progress where appropriate. Ensure all referral activity, communications and outcomes are accurately documented and filed within the patient record. Support the practice in achieving referral processing targets and standards. Manage insurance reports, medical reports and third-party documentation requests in accordance with practice procedures and relevant legislation. Ensure documentation is completed accurately and within agreed timescales. Support patients and staff with queries relating to access to medical records, consent and permissions. Maintain accurate records of requests, actions and outcomes. Escalate complex or sensitive requests to the appropriate manager or clinician. Statutory and Contractual Support Support the management of requests for information, reports and returns relating to the practice's statutory and contractual obligations. Assist with administrative processes required to support regulatory, contractual and operational requirements. Undertake any other reasonable duties requested by the management team in support of the practice's business operations.

title: Patient Administrator
description: We are looking for an organised, efficient and friendly patient administrator for this newly designed post. The postholder will be responsible for clearing the task list in SystmOne, ringing and booking patients in for reviews and tests, and responding to queries. They will work alongside the care navigation team and clinical teams to help deliver an excellent standard of care for our patients. The post is 24-28 hours per week, with days and hours to suit the successful candidate. A GP practice is a fast-paced, teamworking environment, requiring the ability to work under pressure and to absorb regular changes. Excellent attention to detail and high levels of accuracy are required to ensure an excellent and safe service for our patients. Candidates who recently applied for the temporary admin/secretarial post are welcome to apply for this post. Responsible for clearing the admin team task list throughout the week, which will include: Contacting patients to arrange their healthcare reviews, blood tests, etc. either by phone, Anima (eConsultation/SMS system), email or letter. Dealing with patients in a caring, respectful and polite manner. Ensuring patients are kept up to date with the progress of any routine issue they may have raised, e.g. an update on their care pathway, prescription query, etc. Arranging home blood pressure monitoring. Ensuring patient information is passed onto the correct staff member in a timely manner and recorded clearly on the patient record. Liaising with clinical colleagues and managerial staff to ensure the most efficient use of the appointment system. The Patient Administrator is primarily responsible for clearing the admin task list in SystmOne Workflow and booking patients in for their reviews and/or tests in an organised and efficient manner. This post involves a lot of patient contact and so the postholder will be friendly, polite, caring and professional. Primary responsibilities: Clearing the admin teams task list in SystmOne workflow. Contacting patients to organise healthcare reviews and tests, in a kind and courteous manner. Putting patients at ease and providing clear, concise information. Making clear and concise notes of patient interactions and ensuring these are documented accurately in the SystmOne clinical software tool. Dealing appropriately with instructions and queries from clinicians and outside agencies. Maintaining strict confidentiality in relation to all issues concerned within requirements of the Data Protection Act 1984, Information Governance and Caldicott Principles. Remaining up to date with all statutory and mandatory training. Additional (as appropriate) Dealing with patient requests received via the online consult system. Responding to email requests received, as appropriate. Supporting the pharmacy team with patient prescription requests.

title: Medical Receptionist / Care Navigator
description: Job Description This position is perfect for individuals who enjoy helping others, have a passion for health and wellness, and are looking for a team-based work environment. The Care Navigator will work with our clients to ensure that they receive the highest quality of care during their treatment, as well as provide them with all the resources and information they need, including scheduling appointments and helping to control the cost of their care. To have a thorough knowledge of all Practice procedures. To work in accordance of written protocols. Ensure an effective and efficient reception service is provided to patients and any other visitors to the Practice Deal with all general enquiries, explain procedures and make new and follow-up appointments. Using your own judgment and communication skills ensure that patients with no prior appointment but who need urgent consultation are seen in a logical and non-disruptive manner. Explain Practice arrangements and formal requirements to new patients and those seeking temporary cover and ensure procedures are completed. Receive and make telephone calls as required. Divert calls and take messages, ensuring accuracy of detail and prompt appropriate delivery. Enter requests for home visits onto clinical system, ensuring careful recording of all relevant details and where necessary refer to Duty Doctor. Action repeat prescription requests and ensure that they are ready for collection by the patient within 48 hours, either on the computer or manually. Advise patients of relevant charges for private (non General Medical Services) services, accept payment and issue receipts for same. Enter patient information on to the computer as required, i.e. change of addresses, names, telephone numbers and any ad-hoc information as appropriate. Ensure the waiting room is kept tidy in turn with other staff members. Premises Ensure building security have thorough knowledge of doors/windows/alarm. Open up premises at the start of the day when first to arrive, and make all necessary preparations to receive patients. When last to leave at the end of the day, ensure that the building is totally secured, and rooms are tidied and ready for the next day. Ensure that all new patients are registered onto the computer system promptly and accurately, including Temporary Residents. Contact patients for routine screening as appropriate. Do necessary administration of Pathology Data. Arranging transport for patients when necessary. Opening, stamping with date and action stamp all incoming post. Scan hospital letters and patient correspondence in accordance with Practice guidelines. Advising Office Manager when stationary or other equipment is required. Sending faxes to outside organisations when required. Filing clinical letters into relevant concertina files. Action tasks within a timely manner. Restock the reception area. Complete all annual Mandatory training as appropriate Have working knowledge of telephone system, during and after hours Undertake any other additional duties appropriate to the post as requested by the Partners or the Practice Manager. This post requires clear DBS, really good previous references and clean employment track record.

title: Medical receptionist
description: We are recruiting for a medical receptionist to join our friendly and busy team. This role provides reception and administrative support to the whole practice. Customer service experience and IT skills are essential. A knowledge of primary care and the IT system (System One) would be an advantage but not essential as training is provided. Good written and oral communication skills are also essential as well as good time management and organisational skills to prioritise your workload, along with an understand of, and commitment to, patient confidentiality. Welcoming patients to the surgery and providing a friendly and professional reception service.Answering incoming telephone calls promptly and dealing with a wide range of patient queries. Booking, cancelling and rearranging GP, nurse and other clinical appointments. Supporting patients with general enquiries and directing them to the appropriate service. Take accurate messages and relaying information to the relevant team members. Managing the reception area and assisting patients with check-in and other administrative queries. Liaising with GPs, nurses, administrative staff and other healthcare professionals. Maintaining accurate and confidential patient records. Handling sensitive and sometimes challenging conversations calmly, respectfully and professionally. Following practice procedures relating to confidentiality, safeguarding, information governance and patient care. Carrying out general administrative duties to support the smooth running of the practice. Please see receptionist job description attached to this advert in supporting documents. Full training will be provided.

title: Senior Administrator
description: Turning Point is a leading Social Enterprise which supports people with a wide range of complex needs across Learning Disabilities, Mental Health, Substance Use and Public Health. We are currently recruiting for a Senior Administrator working within our Wakefield Talking Therapies. Our NHS Talking Therapies service supports people experiencing anxiety and depression, providing timely access to evidence-based psychological therapies that help people improve their wellbeing, build resilience and move forward in their lives. Passionate about people, you will enjoy the scope and support to enhance your own life and career too, as you gain the experience and training you need to progress with us. Running health and social care services as a social enterprise, we invest every penny back into our care and our people. So, if youre ambitious and ready for a fresh challenge, progress your career with a sector leader. Please note that this role is a 12month FTC. Supervise and support the smooth running of own specific area in keeping with regulations and Turning Points policies and practices in order to provide efficient and high-quality service. Provide a comprehensive administration service by working closely with the wider Management Team and where appropriate, other colleagues . Liaise with service users and stakeholders to facilitate appointments, pathway progression, and effective communication throughout the patient journey. We're looking for a candidate with administration experience. Experience as a Senior Administrator is desired but not essential. A confident communicator who can prioritise a varied workload and provide wide-ranging administrative support and its vital that youre able to achieve this without losing your methodical attention to detail. It would be an essential to have knowledge and experience of Word, Excel and other Microsoft systems and you will be trained on our data systems.To be considered for this role you will need to have: Experience of working in an administrative and customer-focused role within a health and social care, NHS, or similar service environment. Have experience within a fast paced, demand led environment Ability to support a diverse community without prejudice and demonstrate empathy Ability to work flexibly to meet the demands of the service and provide a high-quality client experience Experience using databases to input personal and sensitive information and Microsoft Office 365 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to coordinate across teams, manage stakeholder relationships, and support service delivery in a busy administrative environment. Wakefield Talking Therapies operates Monday to Thursday 8am to 8pm, Friday 8am to 4pm and Saturday 9am to 4pm. The successful candidate would be required to be flexible and work on a shift rota basis to meet the needs of the service. Although, time management, organisational, IT skills are just as important as your communication and people skills. Dynamic and driven, youre someone with a naturally positive disposition and will fit in well in our team.

title: Receptionist/Care Navigator
description: Conway Medical Centre is looking for a Receptionist/Care Navigator for 16 hours per week, days to be negotiated. The Receptionist/Care Navigator is key front-line position responsible for managing the first impressions of the practice. This role involves greeting patients, managing communication between patients and medical staff and facilitating patient access to appropriate healthcare services. The Care Receptionist/Care Navigator plays a crucial role in guiding patients through the complexities of healthcare interactions, ensuring they receive timely and appropriate care. Key responsibilities include scheduling appointments, managing patient records, answering phone calls and providing patients with information about healthcare services. The Receptionist/Care Navigator will ensure that all patient interactions are handled with empathy and efficiency, maintaining confidentiality and compliance with healthcare regulations. This position requires excellent communication skills, strong organisational abilities and a patient-based approach to service delivery. Main duties of the job: Front Desk Management, Appointment booking following Care Navigation triage, Telephone enquiries, eConsultations - Process eConsultations received - Patchs, Patient records management, Summarising, Administrative work as required, - practice email Patient follow-up, Service enhancement initiatives, Training participation, Knowledge upgrading
